# Achievement Trends

This section examines how student achievement in **`r content_area`** has changed over time. By tracking the percentage of students who reached proficiency—based on state-defined achievement levels—we can identify long-term patterns in performance and assess progress across years.

In this analysis, we focus on **`r if (!is.null(target_grade)) paste("Grade", target_grade) else paste("Grades", paste(range(grades), collapse = "–"))`**, examining achievement trends across multiple academic years.

Proficiency is defined as scoring at or above the following achievement level(s): **`r paste(proficiency_levels, collapse = ", ")`**. In some cases, we also highlight students performing at advanced levels, which we define as scoring at or above **`r paste(advanced_levels, collapse = ", ")`**. This distinction helps us monitor not only whether students are meeting expectations but also whether high-performing students are continuing to excel.
